sources.excerpt: P005 – Continuum OD – Collateral FX About Pedals Boost Buffer Chorus Compressor Distortion Fuzz Modulation Overdrive Preamp Vibe Vibrato Search Toggle Menu About Pedals Boost Buffer Chorus Compressor Distortion Fuzz Modulation Overdrive Preamp Vibe Vibrato Home » Pedals » Overdrive » P005 – Continuum OD + + + P005 – Continuum OD Active ingredient – Two legendary overdrives in guitar history available in a compact format. Recommended for – Those who dream of a John Mayer in a Box. There is no denying that John Mayer’s album Continuum is one of the most influential albums for guitarists from 2006 onwards. The killer Strat tone is the result, among other factors, of using pedals like the Ibanez TS10 and the Klon Centaur. And it was the combination of these two classics that resulted in the Continuum pedal, the new release from Collateral FX. But those who think the Continuum is just an attempt to reproduce the sound of the eponymous album are mistaken. The idea here is to bring the characteristics of two classics into one pedal. We took the best of both the TS10 and the Klon, perfected some details, put our own twist on it, and the result was a powerful tool. With the Continuum, you can obviously achieve that Strat sound leaning towards John Mayer and Stevie Ray Vaughan, but you can go further, especially if you combine both channels and crank up the gain. You can also leave one of them on to add some color to the sound and push through solos with the other. The Continuum’s proposal is to bring that atmosphere for fans of John Mayer, of course. But if you’re not so keen on his sound, remember that the Continuum is an opportunity to have in one pedal the two most iconic overdrives in history.
